items.note: S1.2.1-S1.2.4 reproduce the proof at 741-765 exactly (net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c; central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2; three stages giving (-y,x)). But the setting is never given: no h=100, no indexing of X_a,Y_a by triples in T^3, no N or m, and the neighbour and wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783) are absent.

The invariant (stored = D_v applied to the logical array), the commuting of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the per-route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} are all given as in 804-825.

Form (I-J/9), triple-line orthogonality, terminal labels, stage transitions, side-wire inclusion, the single decreasing edge (center 3->4, loss h), telescoping, L=Ich and Sum|dDim|=Wm-2N+2L, orthonormal bases and 100/539, 101/539 are all present. The time-indexed gate labels of eq:motif-labels (A⊗F on X, B⊗F on Y for the central gates) and the edge residual table are not given, so comparability of every edge is asserted from a quote at 1061 rather than shown.

P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N rank-one exceptions 2P_{U_a}, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint difference I_m giving H<-H+D on every role all match 1156-1172; Phi_M frames appear in S1.4.3.2.2.

The phase frame itself, C_U=H^{⊗m} diag(i^{q_U}) H^{⊗m}, is never defined (only q_U is), nor is it said that the full label gives C^{⊗m}.

Splitting into q^2 or q streams, cyclic row dealing with volume V/W, counter costs, block split at Q-a, absorption of b^{O(1)} offset work, multiplication by a unit via c increasing pieces, and negation by stack reversal all follow 513-621.

A=E_1 Pi E_2 by top-row/rightmost-pivot elimination, O(V) triangular transforms in descending order, and each one of Pi realized as D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j with exactly one interchange, as in 1375-1447.

Row split into W role streams of volume V/W, edge shears by recursive interchanges, frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, the three-shear interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric-sum case split, the depth-first parking schedule and descriptor bound all match 1491-1615.

errors.says: Implementing each edge change by s<Wm smaller calls on volume V/W gives cost per volume O(e^tau) at parameter e, both for the bit network and for the complex network (butterfly layers).
errors.paper: Only the bit recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) gives O(e^tau). The complex recurrence has node overhead O((eK)^tau+1) and leaves O(e), and unrolls to O(e^lambda) internally and O(d^{lambda'}) overall, with lambda' > lambda > tau.

errors.says: Method: choose labels so that gather and scatter coefficients depend on the intersection size and the only decreasing edges are the central-wire returns.
errors.paper: The intersection-dependent gather/scatter/side coefficients belong to the scalar network (689-703, 752-758). The labels are chosen so that neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal and every edge joins nested labels (869-870, 939-958); they do not set the coefficients.

errors.says: Over F_2 every nonzero residual contains a norm-one coordinate unit (so it is nonalternating).
errors.paper: The norm-one vector is the tensor product of chosen norm-one vectors, which are triple indicators on the P and Q lines and coordinate units only in the other factors, placed in one orthogonal summand. It is not in general a coordinate unit.

errors.says: Each of the l rounds on the remaining chunks is one application of the simultaneous layer, costing O(Tp d^{lambda'}) per round.
errors.paper: The qK rounds on the remaining chunks are layer calls. The up to b+1 rounds on prefix slots are done individually at cost O(TpdK). The l bound counts all rounds, not rounds on the remaining chunks.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. One network scheme (S1.2-S1.4) produces both tape procedures. These feed the synthetic transforms and the ring convolution (S2), then resampling, chirp and permutation cancellation (S3), then the six-step algorithm with exact recovery (S4), and finally the cost table with min g_i=2 kappa (S5), which gives O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). The chain thins in four places. The network is never instantiated: h=100, N, m=h^3 and the wire counts W_b, W_c are absent. The per-time gate labels and edge residuals are quoted rather than shown. The phase frame C_U is never defined. The disproof of the n log n conjecture is not addressed.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch and its eight-row, three-stage derivation are fully present. Most of the required defining content is not: h=100, the indexing of the banks by a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, and N and m are used undefined. The conservative verdict is therefore chosen.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and each edge costs only D_v D_u^{-1}. Stated with the paper's invariant.

Gates and terminals get nested nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3}, every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edge is center 3->4, which loses P⊗F⊗Q of dimension h. The dimension m of F^{⊗3} and the per-time gate-label table are not written out.
P_V-P_U is the identity on V∩U^perp, so its rank is dim V-dim U. The N exceptions are the first X_a edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one at zero dimension change.
The signed changes telescope to Wm-2N, L=Ich, Sum|dDim|=Wm-2N+2L, and hence s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 gives s_b<W_b m; the complex deficit is 2N-2L_c.

On X_a->Y_a the endpoint difference is P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, and on every other role it is zero source against identity sink. The result f'=Phi_{I_m} f is the shear H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Each edge is applied by recursive interchanges, so a node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children have volume V/W, so F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). With s/W<m^tau, tau=1-2^{-50} (from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20), the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: C2 to C9 are reconstructed with their defining quantities: frames, nested labels with the single loss h, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539, the endpoint identity I_m, E_1 Pi E_2 shears as s recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. Only C1 falls short. The plan derives the bank exchange itself but never sets h=100, the triple indexing, N or m, which are the quantities on which the saving s<Wm is computed.
